proposition.claim:
All TANGO pairwise differences exceed Nemenyi CD=2.30 using q=.05 critical1.96.

Definition5 sets internal capacities1 and claims contraction computes widest paths using unnormalized Definition1 similarities.

Theorem3 O(nk log(nk)); proof drops q² because q<<n; overall complexity then O(nk²d).

Theorem4 predicts CN=(EB)^alpha/(1-EN E(B^alpha)) and claims finite typicality obeys power law.
